data.name: Istifa
data.long_meaning: To ask for something with sincerity and hope. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'istafa', meaning 'to ask' or 'to request'. It is also used in the context of seeking Allah's forgiveness or intercession.

in_urdu.name: استفاء
